systemWallpapers.title: Types
systemWallpapers.subtitle: From still images to interactive web pages, Codelume brings different experiences to your desktop. Choose a wallpaper type that suits your Mac’s performance.

still.title: Still wallpapers
still.performance: Best performance, no extra resource usage
still.description: Set any still wallpaper from Codelume as your macOS desktop wallpaper.

video.title: Video wallpapers
video.description: Loop a video on your desktop or convert it to a wallpaper that transitions from the macOS screen saver.
video.requirements: Screen saver integration requires the website edition and macOS 26 or later.

scene.title: Scene wallpapers
scene.performance: Native macOS framework, high performance, higher resource usage
scene.description: Built with SpriteKit, scene wallpapers support multiple layers, shaders, and animations. Scene elements can respond to mouse movement and clicks.

depth.title: Depth wallpapers
depth.description: Separate foreground and background layers give the image a sense of depth.

web.title: Web wallpapers
web.description: Show web content, animations, and live information on your desktop.

wallpaperModes.title: Modes
wallpaperModes.subtitle: Codelume supports two wallpaper modes. See how they compare below.

native.title: System wallpapers
points: Supports still wallpapers and animated screen saver transitions.
Motion slows to a still image when you return to the desktop.
native.availability: Available only in the website edition on macOS 26 or later. The App Store edition’s sandbox prevents this feature.

codelume.title: Codelume wallpapers
points: Supports still, video, scene, depth, and web wallpapers.
Supports screen saver integration. Animated wallpapers keep playing on the desktop.

wallpaperAuthoring.title: Create wallpapers
wallpaperAuthoring.headline: Create Codelume wallpapers with your agent
wallpaperAuthoring.intro: We turned the Codelume wallpaper bundle specification into open-source Skills. A compatible agent can use them to turn your ideas and assets into checked .bundle files ready to import into Codelume.

standard.title: Standard
features: Import and play still images and videos
Manage your main display and its playlist

pro.title: Pro
pro.price: Paid upgrade · See the purchase screen for pricing
features: Import and play all wallpaper types, including scene, depth, and web wallpapers
Play and manage wallpapers independently on multiple displays
Remove the 20-wallpaper limit from your local library
Export wallpaper bundles and submit to the Wallpaper Hub
pro.availability: Native wallpaper mode and lock screen wallpapers require Pro in the website edition on macOS 26 or later.
